company.name: Galileo Financial Technologies
company.shortDescription: Galileo (SoFi's Tech Platform) is a leading fintech platform that provides modern core banking and payments infrastructure.
company.description:
Who we are: 
GalIleo Financial Technologies, LLC is a financial technology platform differentiated in the marketplace by its unique combination of banking and processing.

What we offer: 
The Galileo Technology Platform offers composable products and features in multiple solution areas, including Banking infrastructure, Payments, Lending, and Risk. 
In addition, we offer managed services that help clients host, run and operate the solutions we develop with them.  

Who we serve: 
The flexibility, scalability and reliability of the Galileo Technology Platform benefits Financial Institutions, Brands and  Fintechs (B2C and B2B) seeking innovative financial solutions that set them apart and provide added value to their customers.

What we’re working on: 
We’re focused on putting this highly configurable platform in the hands of established companies to build the next generation of financial services. 
Clients build and access products, features and services by combining different components of our Tech Platform through modern, open APIs to meet their unique use cases. 

Where we operate: 
Our 1700+ employees have helped hundreds of established companies in 16 countries across North America and Latin America.
